details.note: The combined Plan is construction-ready. The replacement Plan’s settled no-spec Standards-only path, canonical-Skill baseline extraction, append-only ledger, sole semantic auditor, evidence identities, obsolete-path migration, five-fact coverage, scope boundaries, and Apply verification obligations remain intact. No public interface, default, owner, cardinality, or chronology decision remains for construction planning; implementation mechanics and proof now belong to Apply.
